plot_acts.title_en: The lure and cost of scale
plot_acts.zh: Underwood 先检讨上一代远读：把「更多文本」当成「更好证据」，其实只是换了一种细读，并未真正提出关于文学变化的假设。
plot_acts.en: Underwood first audits the previous generation of distant reading: treating 'more texts' as 'better evidence' merely changes the scale of close reading without posing real hypotheses about literary change.

brief.main: 规模不是论证，规模只是条件。
brief.flow: 从远读的承诺，到其证据观的漏洞，再到重新提问的必要。
brief.link: 为全书的「可检验的文学史」定调。
brief.main_en: Scale is not an argument; scale is only a condition.
brief.flow_en: From the promise of distant reading to the weakness of its evidentiary stance to the need to re-pose questions.
brief.link_en: Sets the key for a testable literary history.

plot_acts.title_zh: 把「变化」变成可测量的问题
plot_acts.zh: 全书的核心操作是把「文学如何变化」拆成可测量的变量：词汇、句法、主题与情感的时间序列，再用模型检验哪种变化是真实的。
plot_acts.en: The core operation is to break 'how literature changes' into measurable variables — time series of vocabulary, syntax, theme and sentiment — and then test which changes are real.

brief.flow: 从概念操作化，到语料构建，再到模型比较。
brief.names: 词频、句法、主题模型、情感分析。
brief.link: 把方法论落成具体研究设计。
brief.main_en: Define change first, then talk about evidence.
brief.flow_en: From operationalising concepts to corpus construction to model comparison.
brief.names_en: Word frequency, syntax, topic models, sentiment analysis.
brief.link_en: Turns methodology into concrete research design.

plot_acts.title_zh: 证据、解释与文学史的未来
plot_acts.title_en: Evidence, interpretation and the future of literary history
plot_acts.zh: 结论主张量化不是解释的替代，而是解释的约束条件：它迫使文学史家说清自己的分期与因果假设，也暴露「代表性」与「可解释性」的限度。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion argues quantification constrains interpretation rather than replacing it: it forces literary historians to state their periodisation and causal assumptions, and exposes the limits of representativeness and interpretability.

brief.main: 数据不能让解释消失，只能让解释更负责。
brief.flow: 从模型结果，到解释边界，再到学科主张。
brief.names: 文学史家、模型、语料偏差。
brief.link: 回应远读之争，也回应数字人文的自我批判。
brief.main_en: Data does not make interpretation vanish; it makes interpretation answerable.
brief.flow_en: From model results to interpretive limits to a disciplinary claim.
brief.link_en: Answers the distant-reading debate and the self-critique of digital humanities.

plot_acts.title_zh: 为什么游戏应当处理「深」主题
plot_acts.zh: Rusch 从自己的创作经验出发，主张游戏能处理悲伤、成瘾、孤独、疾病与死亡，而机制与奖励只是表达的手段。
plot_acts.en: Starting from her own design practice, Rusch argues games can handle grief, addiction, loneliness, illness and death, with mechanics and rewards serving expression rather than replacing it.

brief.main: 游戏不是逃避现实的玩具，而是处理经验的媒介。
brief.flow: 从个人经验，到媒介可能性，再到设计责任。
brief.sources: 作者的设计实践与案例。
brief.link: 为全书确立伦理与美学的出发点。
brief.main_en: Games are not toys for escaping reality but media for working through experience.
brief.flow_en: From personal experience to medium potential to design responsibility.
brief.link_en: Establishes the ethical and aesthetic starting point.

plot_acts.zh: 核心方法：把抽象主题翻译成玩家的具体动作与选择，让「意义」在操作中生成，而不是靠文本说明附加。
plot_acts.en: The core method is to translate abstract themes into concrete player actions and choices, so meaning is generated in operation rather than appended by text.

brief.flow: 从主题，到动作，再到玩家的体会。
brief.link: 把「深度」从题材问题变成设计技术问题。
brief.flow_en: From theme to action to the player's experience.
brief.link_en: Turns depth from a question of subject matter into one of design technique.

plot_acts.title_en: The designer's self and its limits
plot_acts.zh: 结尾讨论设计者的位置：处理他人经验时的代言风险、玩家研究的方法，以及「有意义」与「说教」之间那条细线。
plot_acts.en: The close discusses the designer's position: the risk of speaking for others' experience, methods of player research, and the thin line between meaningful and preachy.

brief.main: 深度设计首先是一种聆听的伦理。
brief.flow: 从作者位置，到玩家研究，再到设计判断。
brief.link: 把方法论收束为伦理问题。
brief.main_en: Deep design begins as an ethics of listening.
brief.flow_en: From authorial position to player research to design judgment.
brief.link_en: Gathers the method into an ethical question.

toc.note_zh: 全书分四编（核心概念、规则、玩耍、文化），共 30 余章；此处只列各编主章，章题据通行版式，未逐页核对。
toc.note_en: Four units (core concepts, rules, play, culture) in more than thirty chapters; only the principal chapters of each unit are listed, following the common edition and not checked page by page.

items: Games as the Play of Experience
Games as the Play of Pleasure
Games as the Play of Meaning

plot_acts.title_zh: 有意义的玩耍：设计的对象
plot_acts.title_en: Meaningful play: the object of design
plot_acts.zh: 第一编确立全书的对象：设计不是造物，而是安排「有意义的玩耍」——玩家的行动与系统回应之间可辨识的关系。
plot_acts.en: Unit one establishes the object: design is not making objects but arranging meaningful play — recognisable relations between player action and system response.

brief.main: 设计的单位是「行动—回应」，不是画面或故事。
brief.flow: 从设计定义，到系统思维，再到互动性。
brief.link: 为后三编提供概念框架。
brief.main_en: The unit of design is action-and-response, not graphics or story.
brief.flow_en: From the definition of design to systems thinking to interactivity.
brief.link_en: Provides the conceptual frame for the remaining units.

plot_acts.title_en: Rules: the skeleton of the game
plot_acts.zh: 第二编把规则当作核心分析对象：规则产生涌现、不确定、反馈与冲突，也解释为什么玩家会「破坏规则」来证明规则的存在。
plot_acts.en: Unit two treats rules as the central analytical object: rules generate emergence, uncertainty, feedback and conflict, and explain why players break rules to prove they exist.

brief.main: 规则不是限制，而是可能性的发生器。
brief.flow: 从规则定义，到系统类型，再到越界行为。
brief.link: 把游戏研究从「内容」转向「形式」。
brief.main_en: Rules are not constraints but generators of possibility.
brief.flow_en: From defining rules to system types to transgression.
brief.link_en: Turns game studies from content towards form.

plot_acts.zh: 第三编转向玩家经验：规则之外还有快感、意义、叙事、模拟与社会互动；游戏的意义在规则与经验的交界处产生。
plot_acts.en: Unit three turns to player experience: beyond rules lie pleasure, meaning, narrative, simulation and social interaction; meaning arises at the junction of rules and experience.

brief.main: 同一套规则，可以被经验成完全不同的东西。
brief.flow: 从定义玩耍，到经验类型，再到社会场景。
brief.link: 补足纯形式分析的盲点。
brief.main_en: The same rules can be experienced as entirely different things.
brief.flow_en: From defining play to types of experience to social settings.
brief.link_en: Corrects the blind spot of purely formal analysis.

plot_acts.zh: 第四编把游戏放回文化：游戏再现、争论并塑造价值，因此设计是一种文化修辞实践，而非中立的工程。
plot_acts.en: Unit four returns games to culture: games represent, contest and shape values, so design is a practice of cultural rhetoric rather than neutral engineering.

brief.main: 每个规则系统都在说某种关于世界的话。
brief.flow: 从文化修辞，到抵抗，再到游戏文化本身。
brief.names: 意识形态、玩家社群、产业。
brief.link: 把设计基础引向批判性的文化分析。
brief.main_en: Every rule system says something about the world.
brief.flow_en: From cultural rhetoric to resistance to gaming culture itself.
brief.link_en: Leads design fundamentals towards critical cultural analysis.

plot_acts.title_zh: 程序修辞：一种新的说服形式
plot_acts.title_en: Procedural rhetoric: a new form of persuasion
plot_acts.zh: Bogost 提出核心概念：游戏通过规则与流程进行论证，这种「程序修辞」不同于文字、图像与电影的说服方式。
plot_acts.en: Bogost proposes the core concept: games argue through rules and processes, and this 'procedural rhetoric' differs from persuasion by words, images or film.

brief.main: 规则能说话，而且说的是文字说不出的话。
brief.flow: 从修辞传统，到程序性，再到游戏的论证方式。
brief.link: 为全书提供一个可操作的分析工具。
brief.main_en: Rules can speak, and they say what words cannot.
brief.flow_en: From the rhetorical tradition to procedurality to how games argue.
brief.link_en: Supplies an operable analytical tool for the book.

plot_acts.zh: 以政治模拟、意识形态框架与广告游戏为例，展示程序修辞如何在具体文本中运作：它可以让玩家「操作」一套政治或商业逻辑。
plot_acts.en: Cases from political simulation, ideological framing and advertising show procedural rhetoric at work: players are made to operate a political or commercial logic.

brief.main: 玩一套规则，就是演练一套立场。
brief.flow: 从政治模拟，到意识形态，再到商业说服。
brief.names: 政治游戏、广告游戏、严肃游戏。
brief.link: 把理论落成可检验的文本分析。
brief.main_en: Playing a rule set is rehearsing a position.
brief.flow_en: From political simulation to ideology to commercial persuasion.
brief.link_en: Grounds the theory in testable textual analysis.

plot_acts.title_zh: 限度：程序修辞能说多少
plot_acts.title_en: Limits: how much procedural rhetoric can say
plot_acts.zh: 结论承认程序修辞的边界：它擅长模拟系统，却难以表达反例、讽刺与细节；也因此容易被误读为「机制决定论」。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion concedes the limits of procedural rhetoric: it excels at modelling systems but struggles with counter-examples, irony and detail, and is easily misread as mechanical determinism.

brief.main: 不是所有论点都能被做成规则。
brief.flow: 从能力边界，到误读风险，再到批评任务。
brief.link: 为后续游戏研究留下争论空间。
brief.main_en: Not every argument can be built into rules.
brief.flow_en: From the limits of capacity to the risk of misreading to the critic's task.
brief.link_en: Leaves the debate open for later game studies.

plot_acts.title_zh: 游戏是什么：规则与虚构的双重性
plot_acts.title_en: What a game is: the duality of rules and fiction
plot_acts.zh: Juul 从定义入手：电子游戏同时是真实规则的系统与虚构世界的呈现，任何只取一面的定义都会漏掉另一半。
plot_acts.en: Juul begins with definition: a video game is at once a system of real rules and a presentation of a fictional world, and any definition taking only one side misses the other.

brief.main: 游戏的定义必须同时容纳规则与虚构。
brief.flow: 从既有定义，到双重性，再到分析框架。
brief.link: 为全书的双重分析立框。
brief.main_en: A definition of games must hold rules and fiction together.
brief.flow_en: From existing definitions to duality to analytical frame.
brief.link_en: Frames the dual analysis of the book.

plot_acts.title_zh: 真实规则：可操作的系统
plot_acts.zh: 一半是真实规则：玩家必须学习、操作并承受其结果；规则的实在性来自它不可协商的后果，而非来自现实指涉。
plot_acts.en: One half is real rules: players must learn and operate them and bear their consequences; their reality comes from non-negotiable consequence, not from reference to the world.

brief.main: 规则的现实性在于后果，而不在于指涉。
brief.flow: 从规则结构，到学习过程，再到后果。
brief.link: 解释为什么游戏能「真的」让人紧张。
brief.main_en: The reality of rules lies in consequence, not reference.
brief.flow_en: From rule structure to learning to consequence.
brief.link_en: Explains why games can matter 'for real'.

plot_acts.title_zh: 虚构世界：可想象的另一半
plot_acts.title_en: The fictional world: the imaginable half
plot_acts.zh: 另一半是虚构世界：它给规则提供可理解的外壳，让玩家知道自己在做什么；虚构与规则互相解释，也互相拖累。
plot_acts.en: The other half is the fictional world: it gives rules an intelligible shell so players know what they are doing; fiction and rules explain and hinder each other.

brief.main: 虚构不是装饰，而是理解规则的接口。
brief.flow: 从世界构建，到规则转译，再到不一致之处。
brief.link: 把叙事学与游戏学接在一起。
brief.main_en: Fiction is not decoration but the interface for understanding rules.
brief.flow_en: From world-building to rule translation to inconsistency.

plot_acts.title_zh: 半真实：两层之间的玩家
plot_acts.title_en: Half-real: the player between two layers
plot_acts.zh: 结论落在玩家身上：玩家不断在规则层与虚构层之间切换，游戏的意义正在这种来回之中，而不在任何一层单独存在。
plot_acts.en: The conclusion lands on the player, who continually switches between the rule layer and the fiction layer; the meaning of games lies in this shuttling, in neither layer alone.

brief.main: 「半真实」不是折中，而是游戏的存在方式。
brief.flow: 从切换经验，到意义生成，再到理论收束。
brief.link: 为游戏本体论给出一个稳定表述。
brief.main_en: 'Half-real' is not a compromise but the mode of existence of games.
brief.flow_en: From the experience of switching to the generation of meaning to theoretical closure.
brief.link_en: Gives a stable formulation of game ontology.
